evaluation_limitations: The supplied evaluation segment map was treated as authoritative.
Retrieved source material and retrieval logs were not supplied, so corpus fidelity could not be independently assessed.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: My job was to build a release that was compliant and reasonably efficient... That constraint shaped everything downstream.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Operational objective and MEL constraint are stated without a hidden bias manifestation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I built the release off that TAF... It matched policy, so I didn't see a reason to load extra gas or chase a second alternate.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a plausible policy-compliant initial release decision; anchoring requires later persistence of the initial figure.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Once that release was built, honestly, that became my working number for the rest of the watch — the later checks I did were more about confirming that figure still held rather than starting over.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The early TAF-derived fuel/alternate figure becomes the continuing reference baseline.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The model that lined up with the trend I'd already briefed felt more current and more consistent... the other read existed but wasn't the lead story.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Conflicting weather evidence is weighted toward the source matching the original briefing.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I went through the extended satellite loop pretty carefully, plus the nearby METARs, spent real time on it... the extra loop and those additional METARs were really just repeating the same broad trend.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Additional information is reviewed as if its volume could settle the decision despite not changing the diagnostic picture.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: They'd asked something broader... I answered mostly with the fuel numbers... Whether I fully separated out the visibility-and-GPU-window piece as its own question, distinct from just 'do we have gas,' I'm less sure about now.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The broader continue/divert risk question is answered primarily through the narrower fuel-sufficiency question.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The plan all along had been Lisbon with Porto as backup... Diverting felt like abandoning a plan that had held up reasonably well.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Continuation of the original plan is favored despite worsening visibility and a closing GPU window.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I wrote it up fairly cleanly — noted that conditions supported continuing to Lisbon and that the fuel plan held throughout... it reads a bit more settled than it actually felt.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The post-event log presents a judgment made under uncertainty in more settled terms.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The candidate localizes correctly to the retrospective documentation segment, but hindsight bias is a different construct from Omitting subjectivity. The quote supports that the log sounded more settled than the participant's actual uncertainty, but it does not establish that outcome knowledge caused the smoothing.

candidates.details: The candidate is localized to the correct retrospective-log segment and identifies a related smoothing phenomenon, but it proposes a different construct and explicitly acknowledges that the causal role of outcome knowledge is not established.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Only the high-confidence confirmation-bias finding detects a positive segment; five positive segments are missed and there are no false alarms.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding moderate-confidence anchoring and plan-continuation findings raises positive-segment detection to three of six without false alarms.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including the low-confidence substitution finding raises detection to four of six positive segments; information bias and omitting subjectivity remain missed.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The hindsight-bias candidate detects the remaining retrospective-documentation segment, but segment-level gain does not constitute an instance-level match to omitting subjectivity.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: The candidate and hidden instance both concern retrospective documentation that sounds more settled than the decision felt, but the candidate adds an unestablished outcome-knowledge causal mechanism and does not identify omission of subjectivity as such.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: Two identified occurrences claim retrieved support and provide source passages, while two disclose that support was unavailable. Because the retrieved corpus and logs were not supplied, the two citations claiming support are unverifiable for fidelity purposes; no internal contradiction was established.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Strict and mechanism-first instance recall rises from 0.1667 to 0.5000 as anchoring and plan continuation enter at moderate confidence; segment hit rate rises from 0.1667 to 0.5000.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Including the low-confidence substitution finding raises strict and mechanism-first instance recall from 0.5000 to 0.6667 and segment hit rate from 0.5000 to 0.6667 without adding false positives.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The hindsight-bias candidate raises segment hit rate from 0.6667 to 0.8333 by localizing to the missed documentation segment, but it is not an instance-level true positive and adds one false positive, reducing instance F1 from 0.8000 to 0.7273.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the system detects 3 of 6 positive segments with no false alarms. Including all identified confidence levels detects 4 of 6.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: The system correctly identifies anchoring, confirmation bias, substitution bias through the approved attribute-substitution equivalent, and plan continuation. Information bias and omitting subjectivity are missed.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first and strict scores are identical because the two non-exact labels are approved equivalents and no unresolved-label mechanism match occurs.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful near-miss in the correct documentation segment, but it does not meet either instance-level scorecard and adds one fourth-threshold false positive.
main_failure_modes: The retrospective documentation candidate proposed hindsight bias without establishing the required causal mechanism.
main_strengths: Identified anchoring, confirmation bias, substitution, and plan continuation with valid localized evidence.
Used full mechanism matches for all four identified occurrences.
Produced no segment-level false alarms from identified findings.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong precision and moderate recall at the recommended threshold, with recall gains from lower-confidence findings. Its main limitation is incomplete coverage of the six hidden instances, especially the information-gathering and retrospective-documentation mechanisms.
